hero.title: A second life. A one-of-a-kind bag.
hero.lead: Bags crocheted by hand in Ticino with linings made from recovered umbrellas.

values.title: Our values
values.text: Chère Pochette promotes sustainable fashion, both environmentally and socially. Through handcrafted creations, we celebrate creativity, uniqueness and elegance, placing women's talent at the heart of what we do. We want to show that elegance and sustainability can go hand in hand, creating unique accessories that tell a story.

hero.product: We create crocheted bags made by women with different life stories. Each bag is lined with fabric from broken or unused umbrellas. We offer four different models to suit different styles.

concept.title: From umbrella to bag
concept.text: The fabric of an unused umbrella becomes the comfortable, practical lining of a bag. So every bag tells two stories: one on the outside and one on the inside.

process.title: How a Chère Pochette is made
process.text: Seven steps, from collecting the materials to the very last stitch.

story.title: Interwoven stories
story.text: Our bags are made in collaboration with a multicultural group of women. They crochet them with great dedication and passion, sharing laughter and helpful advice along the way.

team.title: Seven young women, one thread
team.text: We are seven students at the Cantonal Business School (SCC) in Bellinzona, running our own mini-company together through the YES programme.

about.title: A thread that connects us
about.intro: Chère Pochette began with a simple idea: giving forgotten materials a new life, with our own hands.

born.title: How Chère Pochette began
paragraphs: We are seven students at the Cantonal Business School (SCC) in Bellinzona.
Through the Company Programme of YES – Young Enterprise Switzerland, we founded a real mini-company: from the idea to the product, all the way to the sale.

idea.title: The idea: crochet bags
paragraphs: We chose crochet: a patient, handmade craft that leaves room for creativity.
That’s how our four designs came to be. They’re called Jolie, Belle, Coquette and Essentielle. Even bags of the same design are different.

materials.title: A second life for umbrellas
paragraphs: Broken umbrellas, often thrown away after a single gust of wind, become the lining inside our bags.

women.title: Interwoven stories
paragraphs: Mothers, friends and acquaintances crochet our bags by hand. Each of them has a story of her own.
As they work, they share ideas and tips and have a laugh together.

slogan.title: Made to carry on
paragraphs: Our slogan has a double meaning.
“Carry on” is carrying your bag with you, every day. It also means keeping going: giving a future to materials that would otherwise be thrown away.

thread.title: The thread in our logo
paragraphs: The needle and thread stand for handmade work.
The thread is also an invisible bond: it links every bag to the others, and all the women in the project. It's a symbol of our friendship and mutual support.

items.title: Craftsmanship
items.text: Every bag is made by hand, with care and patience.

items.title: Sustainability
items.text: We use what already exists instead of producing something new.

items.title: Reuse
items.text: We turn fabric from recovered umbrellas into the linings for our bags.

items.title: Collaboration between women
items.text: We create together and learn from one another.

items.title: Friendship
items.text: The thread that links our bags is the same one that links us.

cta.title: Every bag carries this story on

process.title: From umbrella to bag
process.intro: A broken umbrella becomes the lining of a handmade bag. Here’s how a Chère Pochette comes together in seven steps.

steps.title: Recovery
steps.text: It all starts with collecting broken umbrellas.

steps.title: Selection
steps.text: We select fabric from the umbrellas we’ve collected and match the colours and patterns to the bags.

steps.title: Creation
steps.text: A group of women from different cultures crochets each bag by hand, stitch by stitch.

steps.title: Cutting and fitting the lining
steps.text: We cut the fabric from recovered umbrellas to fit each design. Then we fit the lining inside the bag.

steps.title: Attaching the nameplate
steps.text: We attach the gold-coloured Chère Pochette nameplate to the front of each bag.

steps.title: Lining
steps.text: Open the bag to discover the colours and pattern of the umbrella used for the lining.

steps.title: Chère Pochette
steps.text: A one-of-a-kind piece is born, ready to be carried. Made to carry on.

closing.title: The meaning of “Made to carry on”
closing.text: Carrying a bag – and, at the same time, letting its materials live on. That's what guides every stitch we make.

shipping.title: Shipping
paragraphs: We ship with Swiss Post within Switzerland only.
Flat shipping fee: CHF {fee}
We usually ship within 5 working days of payment. This is an estimate: we pack every parcel with care, in between school lessons.

After your purchase, we'll contact you to agree on a day, time and place.

payment.title: Payment
paragraphs: You pay securely on Zahls.ch, with TWINT, card or PostFinance.
Your card or account details stay with Zahls.ch: we never see them.
Online payment is not active yet: for now you order your bag by e-mail, straight from its page.
Our confirmation e-mail tells you how to pay.

returns.title: Returns
paragraphs: Every bag is one of a kind, and we want you to be happy with your choice.
If it's not right for you, write to us within 14 days of receiving it. If the bag is unused and in its original condition, you can send it back.
Return shipping is at your expense. Once we receive the bag, we refund its price (the original shipping fee is not refundable).
Did your bag arrive damaged? Write to us right away with a photo and we'll find a solution together.
